aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was started by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks come to his village. It is a small company and he runs it himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something created for a business that is somewhere else every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, I will reply to you personally, not a customer service queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come, but I never knew which one was coming or when, without digging through Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie, a simple way for you to see which food trucks are coming to villages near you.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, item and event and see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you don’t need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.

featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your website. Each one leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.

featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as the WhatsApp auto-replies, for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — and all show the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need to be ordered ahead.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, locations and times for every week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — customers see it as unavailable straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it goes down as orders come in, then the item is automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, without a separate card reader.

featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand is spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take walk-up orders and manage them, with payment on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your business from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card machine you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wi-fi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was created exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers don’t send orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders in the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, locations and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Messages on your WhatsApp get an answer while you drive to the location or stand at the grill, based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon messages on your WhatsApp will get an answer while you drive to the location or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and in under 60 seconds we’ll turn it into a working ordering page so you can try it out. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, no installation. Have a look, then decide.

landing.steps.scheduleBody: Have it on your website? We’ll read it from there and keep it updated. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what we find.
